title: Agent-RLVR: Training Software Engineering Agents via Guidance and Environment Rewards
authors_zh: Jeff Da、Clinton Wang、Xiang Deng、Yuntao Ma、Nikhil Barhate、Sean Hendryx
paper_type_zh: 推理数据、搜索或测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理轨迹、反馈契约、发布边界和复用风险的读者
one_line: Agent-RLVR collects test-verified software-agent trajectories and teacher-guided reattempts, then reuses same-task positive/negative pairs for SFT, offline DPO, and a test-time patch reward model.
Agent-RLVR 收集经测试验证的软件智能体轨迹与教师引导的重试记录，再把同一任务的正负样本对复用于监督微调、离线 DPO 和推理时的补丁奖励模型。
why: For the rollout/search/test-time trace track, it exposes how repository states, execution outcomes, guidance, reattempts, and pairwise patch feedback can be joined into training and selection records, while leaving the underlying dataset and trajectories unreleased.
inclusion_reason: The paper specifies an environment-grounded construction recipe that turns failed software-agent rollouts into teacher-guided reattempts, test-verified trajectory pairs, offline DPO data, and patch-ranking reward-model data.

title: Problem
问题
html: RLVR is straightforward when a short answer can be checked, but software-engineering agents must navigate repositories, interact with execution environments, and make multi-step edits before receiving a sparse terminal signal. Agent-RLVR addresses this setting with records built around a GitHub issue, a Python repository snapshot, a Docker environment, tests, a full agent trajectory and patch, the test outcome, optional guidance, and a guided reattempt. The paper reports 817 training environments across 27 repositories and 8,186 collected trajectories, but does not release those records. For the rollout/search/test-time trace track, the relevant object is therefore not the reported SWE-Bench score; it is the environment-grounded lineage connecting an attempted trajectory, executable feedback, teacher guidance, a new trajectory, and a terminal reward.

短答案可直接校验时，RLVR 的反馈较容易获得；软件工程 agent 则必须先浏览代码仓、调用执行环境并完成多步修改，最后才得到稀疏的终局信号。Agent-RLVR 围绕 GitHub issue、Python 仓库快照、Docker 环境、测试、完整 agent 轨迹与 patch、测试结果、可选 guidance 以及带 guidance 的再次尝试来组织记录。论文报告了来自 27 个仓库的 817 个训练环境和 8,186 条轨迹，但未发布这些记录。对 rollout、搜索与测试时轨迹这一分类而言，关键数据对象不是 SWE-Bench 分数，而是把首次轨迹、可执行反馈、teacher guidance、新轨迹和终局奖励连接起来的环境级谱系。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The core mechanism is guidance-assisted exploration without replacing the verifiable terminal predicate. An agent first attempts a task without guidance; its patch is run against the environment tests. For a failure or missing patch, an external teacher produces three possible information channels: a plan, environment-feedback guidance based on the failed attempt and stack trace, and environment-interaction guidance pointing to relevant code locations. The agent reattempts during training, and correct versus incorrect trajectories for the same task become preference pairs for offline DPO. Positive non-guided traces also supply SFT data, while problem-statement/patch pairs are reused to train a pairwise reward model that ranks 32 patches at test time. Thus the feedback contract combines a binary environment reward, full-episode trajectories, and derived pairwise preferences; guidance is a search aid, not the correctness judge.

核心机制是在不替代可验证终局条件的前提下，用 guidance 扩展探索。Agent 先在没有 guidance 的情况下尝试任务，并在环境测试中执行生成的 patch；若测试失败或没有生成 patch，外部 teacher 会提供三类信息：解题计划、基于失败轨迹与 stack trace 的环境反馈，以及指向相关代码位置的环境交互提示。Agent 只在训练阶段带着提示再次尝试，同一任务的正确与错误轨迹随后组成 offline DPO 的 preference pair。正确的无 guidance 轨迹还用于 SFT，而 problem statement 与 patch 的配对数据被复用于训练 pairwise reward model，在测试时对 32 个 patch 排序。因此，反馈契约同时包含二值环境奖励、完整 episode 轨迹和派生的成对偏好；guidance 负责辅助搜索，并不承担正确性判定。

title: Method
方法
html: The dataset contains issue descriptions, complete repository snapshots, Docker environments, regression and focused tests, guidance, and agent trajectories. The paper says 593 problems come from SWE-Gym and 219 are self-collected with a similar scraping and annotation pipeline, although these counts sum to 812 rather than the reported 817 environments. It samples 16 trajectories per problem during guided and unguided collection, yielding 8,186 trajectories, 4,093 positive. On-policy traces come from Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct and off-policy traces from the guidance model, claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219. A simplified Agentless scaffold retains localization and repair. Twenty percent of positive non-guided trajectories are used for SFT for five epochs at learning rate 1e-5 and sequence length 8k; the complete preference data is used for one epoch of DPO at 1e-6. Each winning trajectory passes all task tests and is paired with an incorrect same-task trajectory. The separate Qwen-2.5-Coder-32B reward model is trained for 500 steps with pairwise loss, learning rate 1e-5, and warmup ratio 0.05, then ranks k=32 patches. Collection temperature, seeds, exact task list, and the accounting between per-task samples and final trajectory count are undisclosed.

数据集包含 issue description、完整仓库快照、Docker 环境、回归测试与定向测试、guidance 和 agent 轨迹。论文称其中 593 个问题来自 SWE-Gym，另有 219 个问题通过类似的抓取与标注流程自行收集，但两者相加为 812，与报告的 817 个环境不一致。引导与无引导采集阶段均对每个问题采样 16 条轨迹，最终得到 8,186 条轨迹，其中 4,093 条为 positive；on-policy 轨迹来自 Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct，off-policy 轨迹来自 guidance 模型 claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219。系统使用只保留 localization 和 repair 的简化 Agentless scaffold。20% 的正确无 guidance 轨迹用于 SFT，训练 5 个 epoch，learning rate 为 1e-5、sequence length 为 8k；完整 preference data 用于 1 个 epoch 的 DPO，learning rate 为 1e-6。每条 winning trajectory 必须通过全部任务测试，再与同一任务的错误轨迹配对。独立的 Qwen-2.5-Coder-32B reward model 以 pairwise loss 训练 500 steps，learning rate 为 1e-5、warmup ratio 为 0.05，随后对 k=32 个 patch 排序。论文未披露采集温度、seed、精确任务清单，也未解释每题采样数如何与最终轨迹总数对应。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The paper reports that, on SWE-Bench Verified, Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct rises from 9.4% PASS@1 to 22.4% after Agent-RLVR, compared with 20.8% for its rejection-sampled Agent-SFT baseline. Adding the patch reward model raises reported PASS@1 to 27.8%. Its guidance ablation reports an average of 165 successful rollouts (20.3%) with guidance versus 138 (16.9%) without, and fewer empty patches. These experiments support the claims that guidance changes rollout yield, offline preference training changes model behavior, and the same patch data can train a selector under the studied setup. They do not establish that the unreleased trajectories or guidance are complete, correctly attributed, contamination-free, licensed for reuse, or uniformly high quality. Six SWE-Bench Verified instances did not compile and were retained in the denominator. The official Scale Labs page verifies the paper and affiliation, but no official code, data, model, or trajectory release was found.

论文报告，在 SWE-Bench Verified 上，Qwen-2.5-72B-Instruct 经 Agent-RLVR 训练后由 9.4% PASS@1 提升到 22.4%，而 rejection-sampling 的 Agent-SFT baseline 为 20.8%；再加入 patch reward model 后，报告的 PASS@1 为 27.8%。Guidance 消融实验给出的平均成功 rollout 数为：带 guidance 时 165 条（20.3%），不带 guidance 时 138 条（16.9%），且前者 empty patch 更少。这些实验支持的边界是：在论文设定下，guidance 会改变 rollout 产出，offline preference training 会改变模型行为，同一批 patch 数据也能训练 selector；它们不能证明未发布轨迹或 guidance 完整、归因正确、无污染、具备复用许可或整体质量可靠。SWE-Bench Verified 中有 6 个实例无法编译，但仍计入指标分母。Scale Labs 官方页面可核验论文与机构归属，但未发现官方代码、数据、模型或轨迹发布。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Relative to ordinary RLVR on independently successful rollouts, Agent-RLVR inserts a teacher-assisted reattempt between failure and policy update, using environment information to make new successful trajectories reachable while retaining unit-test execution as the terminal verifier. Relative to rejection-sampled SFT, it constructs same-task winning/losing full-trajectory pairs for offline DPO; relative to plain test-time sampling, it reuses the collected patch data to train a pairwise reward model for selection. The direction signal for this atlas is the explicit join among environment state, failed trace, privileged guidance, reattempt, test reward, and downstream preference pair. Guidance, offline DPO, unit-test grading, and Agentless-style localization/repair are not individually new; the contribution is their particular construction loop for sparse-reward software-agent training.

与只从独立成功 rollout 进行普通 RLVR 相比，Agent-RLVR 在失败与策略更新之间加入 teacher 辅助的再次尝试，利用环境信息让新的成功轨迹更容易被采到，同时继续以单元测试执行作为终局 verifier。与 rejection-sampling SFT 相比，它为同一任务构造 winning/losing 的完整轨迹对并进行 offline DPO；与普通测试时采样相比，它又复用已收集的 patch 数据训练 pairwise reward model 进行选择。对本图谱而言，方向性信号在于环境状态、失败轨迹、特权 guidance、再次尝试、测试奖励和下游 preference pair 之间的显式连接。Guidance、offline DPO、单元测试评分和 Agentless 风格的 localization/repair 各自都不是新方法；贡献在于它们被组合成适用于稀疏奖励软件 agent 训练的特定构建闭环。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The study is limited to Python, 27 repositories, one offline training iteration, and a simplified Agentless scaffold, so cross-language, cross-scaffold, and online-RL behavior remain unknown. Repository-level non-overlap with the SWE-Bench test repositories is asserted, but the authors acknowledge possible pretraining contamination; item-level decontamination is not reported. Guidance generation is privileged: the appendix prompt exposes the reference patch and, for environment-feedback guidance, the previous trajectory and stack trace, so reuse must preserve whether a hint contains answer or localization leakage. The source counts are internally inconsistent (593 + 219 does not equal 817), and six evaluation environments did not compile. Unit tests may be incomplete and a passing patch is only a terminal predicate, not validation of every intermediate action. No official dataset, code, trajectories, model, exact task list, collection seeds, collection temperature, license, or full reproducibility package was found; benchmark improvements cannot substitute for those missing audit artifacts.

研究仅覆盖 Python、27 个仓库、一次 offline training iteration 和简化的 Agentless scaffold，因此跨语言、跨 scaffold 与 online RL 的表现仍未知。论文声称训练仓库与 SWE-Bench 测试仓库在 repository level 不重叠，但作者也承认可能存在 pretraining contamination，且未报告 item-level 去污染。Guidance 生成使用了特权信息：附录 prompt 会暴露 reference patch；environment-feedback guidance 还会看到上一条轨迹和 stack trace，因此复用时必须保留提示中是否含有答案或定位泄漏的标记。来源计数存在内部矛盾（593 + 219 不等于 817），另有 6 个评测环境无法编译。单元测试可能不完整，通过测试只构成终局判定，不能验证每个中间动作。未发现官方数据集、代码、轨迹、模型、精确任务清单、采集 seed、采集温度、许可或完整复现包；benchmark 提升不能替代这些缺失的审计材料。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For the rollout/search/test-time trace track, Agent-RLVR is useful as a schema for preserving how exploration is changed by feedback. A reusable record should keep the issue and repository revision, Docker image, scaffold and tool calls, initial trajectory, generated or empty patch, exact test executions, binary outcome, teacher identity and prompt inputs, each guidance channel, guided reattempt, same-task winning/losing pair, SFT/DPO membership, and reward-model score. It also illustrates why three predicates must remain separate: passing environment tests, being preferred in offline training, and being selected by a learned reward model. Researchers can compare guidance-assisted rollout construction, environment rewards, preference conversion, and test-time patch selection, but the paper alone does not authorize reuse of the unreleased environments or traces.

对 rollout、搜索与测试时轨迹这一分类，Agent-RLVR 可作为记录“反馈如何改变探索过程”的 schema。可复用记录应保留 issue 与仓库 revision、Docker image、scaffold 与 tool call、初始轨迹、生成或为空的 patch、精确测试执行、二值结果、teacher 身份与 prompt 输入、各类 guidance、带 guidance 的再次尝试、同任务 winning/losing pair、SFT/DPO 归属以及 reward-model score。它也说明了三种判定必须分开保存：通过环境测试、在 offline training 中被偏好，以及被学习型 reward model 选中。研究者可以据此比较 guidance 辅助的 rollout 构建、环境奖励、偏好转换和测试时 patch 选择，但论文本身并未授权复用未发布的环境或轨迹。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• The reported data object is 817 repository environments and 8,186 trajectories, including 4,093 positives; no official data release was found.
  • Guidance has three channels—plan, environment feedback, and environment interaction—and is generated by claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219 with privileged access that can include the reference patch.
  • Environment tests provide the binary terminal reward; same-task correct/incorrect full trajectories become offline-DPO preference pairs.
  • Positive non-guided traces also support SFT, and the problem/patch data trains a pairwise reward model for k=32 test-time selection.
  • Audit the unresolved 593 + 219 versus 817 count mismatch, pretraining contamination, test completeness, release license, seeds, and exact task lineage before reuse.

• 论文报告的数据对象为 817 个仓库环境和 8,186 条轨迹，其中 4,093 条为 positive；未发现官方数据发布。
  • Guidance 分为 plan、environment feedback 和 environment interaction 三类，由 claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219 生成，并使用可能包含 reference patch 的特权信息。
  • 环境测试提供二值终局奖励；同一任务的正确与错误完整轨迹组成 offline DPO 的 preference pair。
  • 正确的无 guidance 轨迹还用于 SFT，problem/patch 数据则训练 pairwise reward model，在测试时从 k=32 个 patch 中选择。
  • 复用前应审计 593 + 219 与 817 的计数矛盾、pretraining contamination、测试完整性、发布许可、seed 和精确任务谱系。
